publication_policy: Noether is at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling. Fold these targeted source-patch packages into the next compact current-control/source-audit rebalance rather than loose-uploading them above reader PDFs/current TeX.
quality_scope: Targeted source-patch support only. The Paper 24 package covers printed pp.237-239; the R270 package covers two post-P43 tail loci on collected pp.747-748. Neither package certifies Paper 24, the tail, the Noether corpus, multilingual synchronization, source closure, or a critical edition.

packages.source_scope: Paper 24 printed pp.237-239, GDZ Math. Ann. 90 native400 full-page images plus enlarged labelled crops.
packages.source_quality_caveat: GDZ native400 best-available local witnesses; enlarged labelled crops are readability aids, not native high-resolution page certification.
packages.tex_result: Applies source-visible German cumulative corrections and builds a 471-page cumulative German PDF with XeLaTeX.

p238 restores barred transformed coefficient polynomials in Hilfssatz I.
p239 restores barred coefficient ideals, Dedekind-Mertens exponent h, H.-N. Anm. 13, equality notation, and Hilfssatz II barred-component proof notation.
